jsch generate --schema https://example.com/refs/embedded.json --out ./model --package model --type Outer

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- go.mod --
module example.com/embpkg

go 1.27
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

// embedded.json declares an embedded $id resource and uses
// $ref to point at it across the document boundary. The
// generator should follow the resolved Schema and emit a
// typed Go field for the child property pointing at the
// inner $defs alias.
func TestOuter_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"child":{"label":"hi"}}`)
	var o Outer
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &o); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if o.Child == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Child = nil, want pointer to inner")
	}
	if o.Child.Label == nil || *o.Child.Label != "hi" {
		t.Errorf("Child.Label = %v, want pointer to 'hi'", o.Child.Label)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(o)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != string(in) {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s", out)
	}
}
